content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: A total of 62 vacant posts of Junior Resident are to be filled under the special recruitment drive for the July 2026 session. The department-wise and category-wise distribution is as follows: The number of vacancies indicated against each post/category is provisional and may vary at the time of selection without notice. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PWBD) candidates is 4%, provided on a horizontal basis in their respective categories.

content_sections.text: FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.qualification: MBBS (including completion of Internship) or equivalent degree recognised by MCI. Only candidates who have passed MBBS (including Internship) between 01.11.2023 and 31.10.2026 will be considered. If selected, permanent Delhi Medical Council (DMC) or State Medical Council registration is mandatory at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected Junior Residents will be placed at level 10 of the pay matrix, with an entry pay of Rs. 56,100 per month, plus usual allowances as admissible. The appointment is for the vacant posts of Junior Residents for the July 2026 session, valid for the remaining tenure up to 31.12.2026. Original certificates (MBBS/BDS Degree Certificate and Medical Registration Certificate) of candidates joining as Junior Residents will be retained by the Academic Section and returned upon completion of tenure after 31 December 2026 or upon resignation (after obtaining all no-dues from concerned departments/sections). If a candidate desires to resign, one month's notice is required; any shortfall in notice period will be treated as a penalty. In the month of December, 15 days' mandatory notice is required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the physical application form from the official website at www.aiimsexams.ac.in. Fill in the required information accurately on the downloaded physical form. Attach self-attested copies of all documents named in the notification. Submit the completed physical form along with supporting documents to Academic Section-II, AIIMS, NEW DELHI. Ensure the application reaches the office between 21.10.2026 and 31.10.2026 till 5.00 PM. Late and incomplete applications will not be considered, and only the physical form is accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The following documents must be submitted along with the physical form at Academic Section-II, AIIMS, New Delhi: DOB certificate / 10th mark sheet / Passing Certificate MBBS mark sheet, Provisional Degree / Degree Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PWBD where applicable; valid OBC-NCL and EWS certificates based on FY 2025-2026 income issued between 01.04.2026 and 31.10.2026) Permanent Delhi Medical Council (DMC) / State Medical Council registration Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) Scorecard (for foreign graduates) INI-CET Exam Scorecard with Rank (July 2026) Internship certificate with completion date between 01.11.2023 and 31.10.2026 Disability certificate issued by a duly constituted and authorised Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospitals/Institutions and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution (for PWBD candidates; candidates will be evaluated by a duly constituted Medical Board to confirm eligibility) Candidates must bring all original certificates (Degree certificate, Internship Completion certificate, Date of Birth, Caste certificate, and NMC/DMC registration) for verification during counselling. Without originals, no candidate will be permitted to appear for counselling.

rows.details: AIIMS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment Notice (No.F.AS/JR.07/2026)

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 62 vacant Junior Resident posts available across 14 specialties under this special recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The physical application form must reach Academic Section-II, AIIMS, New Delhi by 31 October 2026 till 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed MBBS (including internship completed between 01.11.2023 and 31.10.2026) or an equivalent degree recognized by MCI.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Delhi Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Junior Resident at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: Junior Residents receive an entry pay of Rs. 56,100 per month at Level 10 of the pay matrix, plus usual admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How will the selection of candidates be conducted?
faq.answer: Selection will be through counselling based on a merit list prepared from the INI-CET July 2026 rank and MBBS aggregate percentage or FMGE score.

faq.question: Q8. Is this post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The recruitment is temporary for the remaining tenure of the July 2026 session up to 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. When will the counselling be held?
faq.answer: The counselling is scheduled to take place between 02.11.2026 and 04.11.2026, with further details notified later via email.

faq.question: Q10. Who is not eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates who completed MBBS and internship earlier than three years before the start date (prior to 01.11.2023) or after 31.10.2026 are not eligible.
